query:
SELECT 
  p.title,
  p.year,
  COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ', ') as current_tags
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
LEFT JOIN tags t ON pt.tagId = t.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.year
HAVING tag_count < 5
ORDER BY tag_count ASC, p.year DESC
LIMIT 20;
